notes.title: Update Release Notes - Flashing Lights Adjustment
notes.notes:
We've made some visual tweaks to improve the experience for all players! ✨

🔹 Reduced flashing light intensity to make the game more comfortable for photosensitive players.
🔹 Adjusted certain effects to be smoother and less abrupt.
🔹 General visual polish and minor optimizations.

Thanks for your feedback! Keep flipping time and enjoy the game! ⏳⚡
